user.title: Ferroamp Control
user.description: Writable control of the Ferroamp EnergyHub over the local MQTT ExtAPI. The prefix must match the one EMS drives (default 'ferroamp'). Control stays OFF until you enable the 'Ferroamp control enabled' switch.

data.base_topic: Ferroamp ExtAPI MQTT base topic (commands go to BASE/control/request)

data_description.send_statistics: One report per day to stats.rnet.se: driver version, Home Assistant version and installation type, the country you configured in Home Assistant, an approximate position rounded to about 11 km, the battery power the driver is allowed to command, whether control is enabled and in use, whether the grid limit is used, and how many commands the hub refused since the last report. No power readings, no energy, no time series. Never a name, an address, an exact position, a serial number, an MQTT topic or an entity name, and your IP address is not stored. Switching this off also erases what has already been sent. The full list: https://stats.rnet.se/integritet
